_note: Every cutscene (M8; DESIGN.md 'Cutscenes'), in one timeline format: story/cutsceneTimeline.js explains positions (in an anchor's frame: x right, y up, z ahead), camera keys and events. Anchors: player, home, homeDoor, hut, witch, trailCam (the camera that saw her, else camera 1), trailCam:<number> (that camera: clip.night1 is the storm shelter's camera six, M9.1), nearestClearing, clearing:<encounter id>. style: cctv | firstPerson | sweep | black. look: config.postFX.looks. hour: the grade and sky while it plays (else the clock's). light: the camera's light on the actors (else config.cutscenes.actorLight for its look). fps: a CCTV feed's frame rate. world: 'run' keeps the world going (else it holds still). Events: line (dialogue.json id; radio true/false), text, move, pose (stand/kneel/down), show, hide, flare, glitch, fade, emit, lookAt, shake, osd (cut to another camera: look, hour, osd), sfx. rewatch: once played it goes on the comms room's monitors. 'placeholder': the shot is a stand-in until its encounter session makes it properly. Every cutscene is in the debug menu's Cutscenes category (Aaron, Session 11).

cutscenes.name: The gas station: the witch at the treeline (first person)
cutscenes._note: Session 15b (M9.3): stepping back out onto the forecourt after the mutant. She stands dead still at the clearing's edge across the road (anchor herSpot), looking at the store; then turns and runs into the trees (herRun), faster than anything should. A stand-in actor (not the simulated witch): nothing to shoot. Then Ellen (and Junie, once the note's been read).

cutscenes.name: Day 1: the view from the lookout tower (first person)
cutscenes._note: M9.2: the first climb on Day 1 (FirstDay). Anchors from FirstDay: southLight (a small red light blinking far to the south, toward Ground Zero, at the edge of sight: Session 16 (Aaron), Wyatt asks and Ellen says it's the military, a training exercise, so they've been told; it isn't), campsite / smoke (the thin wisp over the campsite's trees, drawn along the line to it at the edge of the fog). Tom steps clear of the platform's corner posts first. The view lingers on the fog and the far light, then turns to the smoke: Wyatt spots the campers' car and Junie the smoke (lines 3-4).

cutscenes.name: Day 1: the campers' camcorder (camcorder)
cutscenes._note: M9.2 (Aaron, Session 15): about 8 seconds of shaky night footage of this same campsite, anchored to its frame (campsite: x right, z ahead from the path in). The camper films the tents and the fire; a blur crosses the frame at the treeline, then again much closer; the shot whips round and drops, and the tape cuts out mid-attack. Never a clean frame of her.

cutscenes.name: Night 1: the witch planting her first sigil (trail cam)
cutscenes._note: M9.2: played by FirstDay on Night 1 as the witch plants at the storm shelter (camera six). Lines 17-19 are in it; line 20 follows it. Still a placeholder shot (the style pass: Session 19).

cutscenes.name: Earl Pruitt's tape: camera four, Night 1 (trail cam)
cutscenes._note: Session 16 (M9.3; DESIGN 'Storm shelter', 'The trail-cam tapes'): Earl's tape, handed in at the comms room (StormShelter plays it as the tapes are handed in; then it's on the monitors). Camera four at the shelter clearing's edge (anchor stormShelter: walking in from home, x right, z ahead), Night 1. The witch is already there, low over the ground beside the hatch (the first sigil going in). Earl and his two kids hurry in from the trees and pull up short. A still beat. She turns, far too fast; they scatter out of frame, the kids one way into the trees and Earl the other, and she goes after him. The kill is never shown. The clearing empties; the last seconds are the hatch alone and the sigil's faint glow. The family watch it in the comms room: Wyatt first, Ellen explains, Junie catches the kids running off (Aaron: maybe they got away), Wyatt ties the glow to the sigil Tom dug up.

Anchor outpostC7: the container's middle, facing out of its torn-open end (z ahead; its bent-out side is to the left, -x). Low on the shed husk in front of it, round to the bent side and up the claw gouges high inside, then above, down into the box: the peeled roof, scorch, the snapped restraints. After it (skipped or not) Wyatt and Ellen (Outpost.playC7).

cutscenes.name: The outpost: C-4's doors open on the body in the resin (first person)
cutscenes._note: Session 17 (Aaron: put doors on C-4; opening them is the reveal). Tom hauls the doors; the camera turns onto the grey body in its amber block (anchor outpostResin, from Outpost), a jolt; the doors swing on (the world runs). Wyatt and Ellen after it (Outpost.openResin).

cutscenes.name: The outpost: the dogfight through the hunting rifle's scope
cutscenes._note: Session 17 (M9.4; DESIGN.md 'Overrun military outpost' beat 6): the first time Tom raises the hunting rifle's scope up the outpost's watchtower (or, if he never climbs it, as he crosses the barricade). Through the scope (look scope: a 4x round view), a patrol plane chasing a craft of lights, trading fire; the craft's ray hits the plane, the plane's guns hit the craft; the plane dives in, the craft limps away south and comes down far off. Both come down where the map puts the crashed plane and the crashed UFO (Session 17, Aaron). Anchors (from Outpost.dogfightAnchors): dogfight (Tom's eye, facing the plane's crash site), fight (the fight, along that line), planeCrash and ufoCrash (each facing away from Tom). near 60: the scope sees past the trees round the outpost and the tower itself (they'd fill the view). The plane and the craft are unlit (they read as shapes by day and by their lights at night). Lines inside are cleared if it's skipped; Ellen's after it plays either way (Outpost). The crashes' flashes light the sky over the treeline (over: no depth test), and their smoke stands tall enough to show over it.
